title: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff: This isn’t our first SaaSpocalypse
description: Salesforce reported a solid year-end earnings and then pulled out all the stops to ward off more talk of the death of its business to AI.
author: Julie Bort

title: Gushwork bets on AI search for customer leads — and early results are emerging
description: Gushwork has raised $9 million in a seed round led by SIG and Lightspeed. The startup has seen early customer traction from AI search tools like ChatGPT.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Anthropic acquires computer-use AI startup Vercept after Meta poached one of its founders
description: Seattle-based Vercept developed complex agentic tools, including a computer-use agent that could complete tasks inside applications like a person with a laptop would.
author: Julie Bort

title: Nvidia has another record quarter amid record capex spends
description: "The demand for tokens in the world has gone completely exponential," Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said about the company's earnings.
author: Russell Brandom

title: The White House wants AI companies to cover rate hikes. Most have already said they would.
description: Many hyperscalers have already made public commitments to cover electricity cost increases.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Alphabet-owned robotics software company Intrinsic joins Google
description: Nearly five years after graduating into an independent Alphabet company, Intrinsic is moving under Google's domain.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Wearable startup CUDIS launches a new health ring line with an AI-fueled ‘coach’
description: The wearable incentivizes healthy behavior with points that can be redeemed for health products.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: The public opposition to AI infrastructure is heating up
description: Public backlash over the data center boom is leading to a variety of draconian policies — including bans on new construction.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Gemini can now automate some multi-step tasks on Android
description: Gemini on Android will be able to automate tasks involving rideshare requests, or grocery or food delivery, says Google.
author: Sarah Perez

title: OpenAI COO says ads will be ‘an iterative process’
description: COO Brad Lightcap noted that ads can add to the product experience of users if they are done right. He urged to give OpenAI a few months to see how the company fares in rolling out the product.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenClaw creator’s advice to AI builders is to be more playful and allow yourself time to improve
description: Peter Steinberger talks about the creation of his viral AI agent OpenClaw and how being more "playful" makes for a better way to learn AI coding.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Have hard-won scaling lessons to share? Take the stage at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
description: Apply to speak at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 by April 17 for a chance to lead a roundtable or breakout session for 1,000 founders and investors. If you’ve built, backed, or operated inside high-growth startups, your experience could shape how the next wave of founders scales.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: About 12% of US teens turn to AI for emotional support or advice
description: General-purpose tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok are not designed for this use, making mental health professionals wary.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: 3 days left: Save up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
description: Just 3 days left to save up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket. Offer ends on Friday, February 27 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Don't miss unparalleled, curated networking and valuable insights from 250+ tech leaders, and discover 300+ breakout innovations. Register now.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: US tells diplomats to lobby against foreign data sovereignty laws
description: The Trump administration has ordered U.S. diplomats to lobby against countries' attempts to regulate how American tech companies handle foreigners' data.
author: Rebecca Bellan
